data.summary:
**When:** [Either player's Fight phase](vsdata:core-rule/fight-phase), after one of your **GENESTEALER CULTS CHARACTER** models is **destroyed** by an enemy unit.

**Target:** That **destroyed** **CHARACTER** model. It can be targeted despite being destroyed.

**Effect:** Roll a D6: on a 2+, the enemy unit that destroyed it takes D3 [mortal wounds](vsdata:core-rule/mortal-wounds), or 2D3 mortal wounds instead if the destroyed model is a **PATRIARCH** or **ABOMINANT**.
